matched_design.unit: family cluster, including its full shared source and all clause applications
matched_design.before: existing per-clause source/claim-kit route without NORTON shared answers
matched_design.after: NORTON factual answer once, then separate review of each clause applicability
matching: same frozen inputs and legal cutoff
same exact factual question and clause scopes
same review standard and integration gates
matched_design.contamination_control: Do not let a producer or reviewer work in both arms. Freeze separate source snapshots. The whole family and shared-source acquisition cost belongs to each arm; never split dependent clauses across arms. Source discovery in one arm may not be passed to the other. This session has read these pilot sources and cannot act as a fresh control producer.
matched_design.cost_boundary: Total source acquisition, extraction, producer, independent factual and applicability review, corrections, claim-kit assembly, checker and integration. Keep elapsed time, active time, model tokens, cached tokens and session-dollar bills separate.
matched_design.cost_missing: No Junto add-test without actual complete arm bills and independently reviewed units.

preflight_stop: If no primary source supports a dated receipt or precise transfer provision with adequate identity, edition and applicability, retain all holds; do not run expensive arms or substitute different families.
scale_gate: Stop expansion unless feasibility gate passes and a complete independently reviewed matched cost comparison demonstrates benefit. Report additional integrated-ready cases separately.
zero_cohorts: appointment event not selected: no source-bound repeated appointment obligation identified by initial screen
